facts.business: Raj Rayon Industries Limited is engaged in manufacturing of polyester yarn and related products.

auditor.name: Bagaria & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Management is in the process to obtain details of three inoperative bank accounts which are continuing in the name of the Company from prior to the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process when the current management was not in charge of the affairs of the Company. Accordingly, we are unable to comment on the impact, if any, on the financial statement arising out of subsequent availability of such pending bank statements.

key_risks: Capitalisation of Property, plant & equipment involves significant judgment and estimates
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into related party transactions upon implementation of NCLT order and these transactions are not having any potential conflict with the interests of the Company at large which form a part of the financial statements as required under Ind AS-24.
